<b>Mossberries</b> are [[Items_(Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are mostly found in the [[Mosslands]], recognisable by their bright green glow.

== Use ==
Mossberries can be given to [[Moss Druid]] to complete the <i>[[Berry Picking]]</i> [[Wish]]. 
3 berries are required for the completion of the wish, upon which Moss Druid will give the [[Druid's Eye]]. 

Additional berries can be sold to Moss Druid for [[Rosaries]] ({{R|131}}/{{R|157}}/{{R|173}} in a random order) after the wish has been completed. 

Upon delivering all 7 Mossberries, [[Moss Druid]] will give the [[Druid's Eyes]], an upgraded version of Druid's Eye.

== Trivia ==
* Mossberries share the same sprite as [[Pollip Heart]]s for when the item has not been picked up. This base sprite is not coloured, instead being given its in-game appearance by post-processing effects or a shader.
